moments.action: A held take at a temple: M's bowed head fills frame, then the camera pulls back to a sunlit courtyard under red lanterns as he walks barefoot beside Amah, who follows slowly on her cane.

Close on Amah in profile, talking as she looks across the temple yard; the film then cuts down to handwritten coffin-donation slips on a pink table, hers joined by a second slip in different handwriting.
New location: a wide of a packed third-class train carriage, greenery streaming past the windows, with M seated mid-aisle turned back toward Amah's white head at the window seat behind him.
Shot/reverse between M and Amah on the moving train: he faces front and talks, she watches him over her cane; by the last pair he has turned sideways, sullen, and she has turned away to the window.
Exterior held take: the train slides across frame past a green tin house with city towers behind, and once it has passed the track is left empty with people walking along the bridge.
